question: Which country has the lowest global resilience score?
query: SELECT country_name, global_development_resilience_index FROM global_development_indicators ORDER BY global_development_resilience_index ASC LIMIT 1;  This SQL query selects the name of the country and its corresponding Global Development Resilience Index from the 'global_development_indicators' table, orders it by descending values (lowest resilience score first), then limits results to just one row which will be the country with the lowest global development resilience index.
